# National Park Service (NPS.gov)

> > The official gateway to America's 423 national parks, monuments, and historic sites, enabling discovery, planning, and exploration of protected natural and cultural heritage across all 50 states and U.S. territories.

NPS.gov serves as the primary digital hub for the U.S. National Park Service, providing comprehensive park directories, visitor planning resources, and educational content about America's natural wonders and historic sites. The site emphasizes accessibility through state-based navigation, entrance pass information, and youth engagement programs.

## Key Topics

- National Park Service
- National Parks
- Historic Sites
- Civil Rights History
- National Monuments

- Harriet Tubman Underground Railroad

## Core Navigation & Planning

- [NPS.gov Homepage](https://www.nps.gov/index.htm): NPS homepage: discover America's stories, plan visits, explore national parks
- [Find a Park](https://www.nps.gov/findapark/index.htm): Find national parks by state, entrance passes, fee-free days information

## State Park Directories

- [California](https://www.nps.gov/state/ca/index.htm): California parks directory: Alcatraz Island, San Francisco, historical sites
- [Florida](https://www.nps.gov/state/fl/index.htm): Florida parks directory: Everglades, Big Cypress Preserve, protected areas
- [Hawaii](https://www.nps.gov/state/hi/index.htm): Hawaii parks directory: Haleakalā, Ala Kahakai Trail, volcanoes, culture
- [District of Columbia](https://www.nps.gov/state/dc/index.htm): Washington DC parks directory: memorials, African American Civil War Memorial
- [Alaska](https://www.nps.gov/state/ak/index.htm): Alaska parks directory: Katmai, Alagnak Wild River, Bristol Bay wilderness
- [Arizona](https://www.nps.gov/state/az/index.htm): Arizona parks directory: monuments, Butterfield Trail, Native American heritage
- [Colorado](https://www.nps.gov/state/co/index.htm): Colorado parks directory: Amache, Granada Relocation Center, monuments
- [Georgia](https://www.nps.gov/state/ga/index.htm): Georgia parks directory: Andersonville National Cemetery, Civil War sites
- [Illinois](https://www.nps.gov/state/il/index.htm): Illinois parks directory: Emmett Till memorial, civil rights, Lincoln sites
- [Arkansas](https://www.nps.gov/state/ar/index.htm): Arkansas parks directory: Buffalo National River, Arkansas Post historical sites
- [Alabama](https://www.nps.gov/state/al/index.htm): Alabama parks directory: Birmingham Civil Rights, Horseshoe Bend, Freedom Riders
- [Connecticut](https://www.nps.gov/state/ct/index.htm): Connecticut parks directory: Appalachian Trail, Coltsville Historical Park
- [Delaware](https://www.nps.gov/state/de/index.htm): Delaware parks directory: Captain John Smith Chesapeake, revolutionary history
- [Idaho](https://www.nps.gov/state/id/index.htm): Idaho parks directory: City of Rocks, California Trail, rock climbing geology

## U.S. Territories

- [American Samoa](https://www.nps.gov/state/as/index.htm): American Samoa parks directory: National Park of American Samoa, Pago Pago
- [Guam](https://www.nps.gov/state/gu/index.htm): Guam parks directory: War In The Pacific National Historical Park, Asan

## Seasonal Events & Celebrations

- [Spring Season Celebrations](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/npscelebrates/spring-season.htm): Spring season celebrations: Cherry Blossom Festival, National Park Week events
